new-term-radar.description: Finds the names of new AI models, products and repositories on X, Hugging Face, GitHub and sitemaps, and builds a keyword table for them: the generic search terms behind each name, sized with Google Ads volume and Google Trends, with prioritize, watch or skip. recent_leads is free; keyword_table and run_radar make paid calls through your AIsa key. Source: https://github.com/zhuyansen/new-term-radar
